title: Tune the fiddles of Leprechaun Village to play for the leprechauns
name: Tune the fiddles of Leprechaun Village to play for the leprechauns
description: The Rainbow Sentinel can tune the fiddles of Leprechaun Village to play for the leprechauns. The Sentinel works it under the Absolute Light-Angle Mandate, bending all gloom into harmless light at 42 and 51 degrees - a Signature tale, not a real device.
